history_cutoff: Strictly before target day; current-day events are added after all features for that day are emitted.
amount_seen: Exact float64 monetary value in same account/currency/direction, first_day < target_day. Pair lookup also requires same paid amount/currency.
currency_roles: Source outgoing paid/payment currency; destination incoming received/receiving currency.
z: log1p amount vs previous-day-inclusive population mean/std; std floor .001; clipped [-10,10]; no history -> 0.
mean_ratio: log1p(target amount / past mean amount); absent or zero mean -> 0, with past count retained.
activity: log1p(current-day directional currency count)-log1p(past count / calendar days since first past activity).
first_occurrence: Built from observation-only full input, but only Boolean past existence is used, never future first date or future count.
